access.admin.card: Give existing users and groups a role, and see who holds which role.
access.admin.description: Give existing users and groups a role. A role decides what a person may see and change in the panel.
access.admin.dialog.description: Choose a user or a group, and the role they get. You can only give roles you could hold yourself.
access.admin.dialog.expiresHint: The role ends at the end of this day (UTC). Leave empty for no end date. The Owner role never expires.
access.admin.dialog.expiresInvalid: Choose a day in the future, at most two years ahead.
access.admin.dialog.groupRoleHint: Roles that manage access or the connection cannot be given to a group.
access.admin.dialog.pickFirst: Choose a user or a group first.
access.admin.dialog.search: Search by name or e-mail address
access.admin.dialog.searchHint: Type at least two characters. Only the first results are shown.
access.admin.dialog.title: Assign a role
access.admin.empty: No role has been assigned yet.
access.admin.loadError: The role assignments could not be loaded
access.admin.remove.description: The person or group loses this role at once. People who hold the role through another assignment keep it. The change is written to the audit log.
access.admin.remove.label: Remove the role {role} of {name}
access.admin.remove.title: Remove role
access.admin.title: Roles and access
access.admin.unresolvable: The membership of some groups could not be checked. Roles from those groups may not apply.
access.error.privileged_role_group: This role cannot be given to a group, because whoever manages the group would then control the panel. Give it to individual people, or choose another role for the group.
access.page.description: Your roles and what they allow. This page only shows your access; it changes nothing.
access.page.loadError: Your access could not be loaded
access.page.readOnly: To change your access, ask an Owner of the panel.
access.page.title: My access
access.permissions.description: What you can do with all your roles together. The server decides for every action; this list is for information.
access.permissions.heading: Effective permissions
access.roles.breakGlass: A break-glass session has no roles. It holds one permission only: managing roles and access.
access.roles.heading: Roles
access.stale.checked: Your group memberships were last checked on {time}.
access.stale.message: The panel could not determine your group memberships, so roles from groups may be missing. Sign in again to retry.
access.stale.title: Group memberships may be out of date
